title: 第2519章 末日系统五56第2518章 末日系统五55
content_zh:
一群僵尸本着，这里有五色使者盯着，也就开心的去找皇极经世书的麻烦。黄子则依旧是兢兢业业的，盯着阮梦梦，盯着金未来。
金未来被发现变成僵尸后，第一时间就被况国华等人监控起来，更是直接搬去waitingbar，只有在马叮当和求叔的看管下，魔星尼诺还是能好好的生存下去的。
由于这次僵尸们都混的比较熟，所以，求叔还是没那么排斥僵尸的，加上这边直接有将臣剧透，求叔认命的，跑去准备新鲜血袋，另一边，有将臣控制着，蓝大力也不敢多说什么。
韩紫枫还是觉得，留着堂本静这个不定因素，谁知道会出现什么事情，也就叫将臣暗箱操作一下，收了堂本静的僵尸血。
由于堂本静是真不干什么好事，所以这个事情由马叮当牵头，就这么愉快的决定啦。将，臣能说什么？安排，反正不是大事。事实也证明，真的没什么大事，况复生一个过去一趟，就把那滴僵尸血给吸了回来。并且把一些不符合期待的，也都一波带走，主打一个不给自己找不开心。
金未来严格的说，对堂本静也没什么想法，毕竟，在金未来的眼中，这个哥们就是个神经病不说，还是个渣父，更是个杀人犯，那点都不符合择偶标准。
很快，一群僵尸打完皇极经世书回来，黄子很不开心的投诉，短短一星期时间，阮梦梦几乎一天死三次，还是各种意外，唯一叫阮梦梦比较开心的是，她一天也能上三四次的电视，全是社会新闻啊。
车祸，抢劫银行，高空坠物，下水井盖消失等等，主打一个难难不同，但作为保镖的五色使者，那叫一个头疼。他们明确知道，僵祖说要保证这个女人的生命，还不让变僵尸，他们也就只能，看着紧点。
好在，黄子虽然不是僵尸，但速度也不慢，基本上是赶得及救人的。反正一来二去的，阮梦梦看黄子这个警察的眼神都不清白啦。黄子也是很无奈，就想知道，一个人，为啥能倒霉成这样。
甚至黄子都把人拎去马小玲那里驱邪了，听说阮梦梦的丰功伟绩，马小玲也挺无奈的，是有点衰，经过观察，她发现，这个傻姑娘，居然祭拜阿呆那个倒霉鬼，这种情况，不倒霉才是奇怪吧？
马小玲很质疑的问：“谁叫你祭拜那个鬼的？”
阮梦梦回答：“我看着他可怜，就给他烧点香，怎么了？”
黄子那个气，突然感觉他辛辛苦苦的保护这个丫头，有种喂了狗的感觉怎么破？黄子没好气的说：“你能倒霉成这样，多亏他保佑，不然你能过的安稳不少。”阮梦梦就感觉老尴尬了。
只是这个孩子主打一个热情，心软，虽然自己已经这么倒霉了，但阿呆的香火，愣是没停。这波就算紫枫，都佩服的来一句：“勇士啊。”主打一个不拿五色使者的命当命是吧。
或许是皇极经世书那边被欺负的挺惨的，总之，阮梦梦这边虽然险死还生，但真就一点性命之威都没有，倒是阮母这边，也开始出现诡异的事情，原本应该是被堂本静撞，现在呢，她居然被飞机撞。
真的，打架看着撞大厦的飞机，满心满脑的马麦提，不是，不是这个飞机撞大楼是认真的？更搞笑的是，除去阮母，是一个死的都没有。
紫枫都捂脸啦：“不是，我虽然读书少，但这么大个时间，死亡人数1，合理吗？这也太荒诞了些吧？天书这是合不上了硬合是吧？”
将臣也一捂脸：“不是，这么大个飞机是怎么飞过来的？”
紫枫吐槽：“这个精准度，你都不能撞的这么有针对性吧？”将臣现在的脸是抽的挺厉害的。
黄子冷不丁插一句：“这个可以索赔。”

一群人顿时很无语的看着她，这里都死人了，你开心要求索赔，合理吗？好在，现在嘉嘉大厦就是闲人多，更何况，蓝大力着实闲了很久了，于是一群人开开心心的去找航空公司的麻烦了。毕竟，虽然说损失确实不算大，但现在嘉嘉大厦上面镶一个飞机，有不是一个事儿啊。
倒是马小玲，一下就把怒气全散在阿呆那里，这个衰神，他哪怕幸运一点，这种极端的事情，也不能出现。现在整个嘉嘉大厦，都快成地标性建筑了，谁家好房子上面镶一个真飞机的。
至于航空公司那边，也是很无语，他们也想知道，他们家飞机是咋镶人家房子里的？这不科学。阮梦梦虽然是好脾气，但跟着去的蓝大力和黄子，可都不是什么好脾气，最后愣是敲诈了人家200万。
阮梦梦现在除去伤心，也没什么别的想法，突然多了这么一大笔钱，她疯给蓝大力和黄子每人三十万谈判费，再次给了王珍珍一百万，修房子的。剩下就是给让小玲和求叔帮忙办后事，剩下的钱，她往银行一存，继续该打工打工。
看着他这么平稳的打工心态，一群人也是挺无语的。这个事件的后续，叫大家更无语，那就是飞机，原则上是一点故障都没有，也不知道为啥，就直直撞到人家居民楼上了。
这个说法王珍珍表示：不理解但尊重，你们赔钱就完事了。阮母一个受伤的世界达成！
整个事件下来，一群不开心的僵尸，再次跑去堵皇极经世书啦，不揍它不行啦。紫枫这边看着他们搬飞机，都快笑抽了，这个事件主打一个离了大谱。
现在他们的异能小团体中，都觉得天书设定有病吧？好人谁这么玩啊？别说，这边的记者是真靠谱也是真不怕死，天天在嘉嘉大厦门口蹲后续。
另一边，司徒奋仁最近也不好过，因为洋紫荆小姐的事情，被电视台一路到底，现在几乎也变成苦命打工人。嘉嘉大厦发生这么大的事情，围观最热闹的就是他。
：8xiaoshuo。：wap.8xiaoshuo
content_en:
A group of zombies happily went to trouble Huangji Jingshi Shu because there were five-color messengers watching here. Huang Zize was still working hard, staring at Ruan Mengmeng and Jin Weilai.
After Jin Future was discovered to have turned into a zombie, he was immediately monitored by Kuang Guohua and others, and even moved directly to the waiting bar. Only under the supervision of Ma Dingdang and Uncle Qiu, Demon Star Nino can still survive well.
Since the zombies were all familiar with each other this time, Uncle Qiu was not that repulsive to zombies. In addition, there was a direct spoiler of Generals here. Uncle Qiu accepted his fate and ran to prepare a fresh blood bag. On the other side, there were generals controlling him, and Lan Dali did not dare to say anything.
Han Zifeng still felt that if Domoto Jing was left as an uncertain factor, who knew what would happen, so he asked the general to operate in secret and collect Domoto Jing's zombie blood.
Since Domoto Shizu really doesn't do anything good, Ma Dingdang took the lead on this matter, and it was decided happily. General, what can I say? Arrangement is not a big deal anyway. Facts also proved that it was really nothing serious. Kuang Fusheng went over and sucked back the drop of zombie blood. And we also took away some things that did not meet our expectations, focusing on one thing so as not to make ourselves unhappy.
Strictly speaking, Jin Mirai has no idea about Domoto Shizu. After all, in Jin Mirai's eyes, this buddy is not only a psycho, but also a scumbag father and a murderer. That does not meet the criteria for mate selection.
Soon, a group of zombies came back from playing Huang Ji Jing Shi Shu. Huang Zi complained very unhappy. In just one week, Ruan Mengmeng died almost three times a day, and there were various accidents. The only thing that made Ruan Mengmeng happy was that she could be on TV three or four times a day, all of which were social news.
Car accidents, bank robberies, objects falling from heights, manhole covers disappearing, etc. The main themes are different, but as a five-color messenger as a bodyguard, it is a headache. They clearly knew that Zombie Ancestor said that he would ensure this woman's life and prevent her from turning into a zombie, so they could only watch her closely.
Fortunately, although Huang Zi is not a zombie, he is not slow either. He can basically save people in time. Anyway, after going back and forth, Ruan Mengmeng couldn't even look at Huang Zi, the policeman, clearly. Huang Zi was also helpless and wanted to know how a person could be so unlucky.
Even Huang Zi took people to Ma Xiaoling to exorcise evil spirits. After hearing about Ruan Mengmeng's great achievements, Ma Xiaoling was quite helpless and a little weak. After observation, she found that this silly girl actually worshiped the unlucky guy Dui. In this situation, it is strange not to be unlucky, right?
Ma Xiaoling asked doubtfully: "Who told you to worship that ghost?"
Ruan Mengmeng replied: "I saw how pitiful he was, so I burned some incense for him. What's wrong?"
Huang Zi was so angry that he suddenly felt that he had worked so hard to protect this girl, and it felt like he was feeding a dog. How could he break it? Huang Zi said angrily: "You are so unlucky, thanks to his blessing, otherwise you would have lived a much more stable life." Ruan Mengmeng felt embarrassed.
It's just that this kid is passionate and soft-hearted. Although he is so unlucky, Dumb's incense never stops. In this wave, even Zifeng said in admiration: "Warrior." The main character is not taking the life of the five-color messenger as his fate, right?
Perhaps it was because Huangji Jingshishu was bullied miserably. In short, although Ruan Mengmeng narrowly escaped death, she really had no chance of losing her life. On the other hand, strange things began to happen on Ruan's mother's side. She was supposed to be hit by Domoto Shizuki, but now, she was actually hit by a plane.
Really, when Mameti was fighting and watching the plane hit the building, his heart was full of thoughts. No, wasn't he serious about the plane hitting the building? What’s even more funny is that except for Ruan’s mother, no one died.
Zifeng covered her face: "No, although I don't have much education, but in such a big time, the death toll is 1.Is it reasonable? Isn't this too absurd? The Heavenly Book cannot be closed, right? "
The general also covered his face: "No, how did such a big plane fly here? "
Zifeng complained: "With this accuracy, you can't even hit it so targeted, right? "The general's face is very slapped now.
Huang Zi suddenly interjected: "You can claim compensation for this. "
A group of people suddenly looked at her speechlessly. People are dead here. Are you happy to ask for compensation? Is it reasonable? Fortunately, there are many idle people in Jiajia Building now, not to mention that Lan Dali has been idle for a long time, so a group of people happily went to find trouble with the airline. After all, although the loss is indeed not huge, it is not a big deal if there is an airplane built on top of the Jiajia Building.
Ma Xiaoling, on the other hand, immediately directed all her anger towards Ah-Dai. Even if this degenerate god was a bit lucky, such extreme things would not happen to him. Now the entire Jiajia Building is almost becoming a landmark building. Who has a good house with a real airplane built into it?
As for the airlines, they were also speechless. They also wanted to know how their planes were built into other people's houses. This is not scientific. Although Ruan Mengmeng was good-tempered, Lan Dali and Huang Zi who followed him were not good-tempered. In the end, they extorted 2 million from others.
Ruan Mengmeng didn't have any other thoughts except being sad. She suddenly had such a large amount of money. She frantically gave Lan Dali and Huang Zi 300,000 yuan each for negotiation fees, and gave Wang Zhenzhen another 1 million to repair the house. The rest was for Xiaoling and Uncle Qiu to help with the funeral arrangements. She would deposit the remaining money in the bank and continue working.
Seeing his stable working attitude, a group of people were quite speechless. The follow-up to this incident left everyone even more speechless, that is, the plane, in principle, had no malfunction at all, and for no apparent reason, it crashed into a residential building.
Wang Zhenzhen said: I don’t understand but respect this statement. Just pay the money and it will be over. Ruan Mu’s wounded world is achieved!
After the whole incident, a group of unhappy zombies ran to block the Huangji Jingshi Book again, and they couldn't do it without beating it. Zifeng looked at them moving the plane and almost burst out laughing. The main focus of this incident was completely off the mark.
Now among their small supernatural groups, everyone feels that there is something wrong with the setting of the Book of Heaven, right? Who is a good person who plays like this? Not to mention, the reporters here are really reliable and not afraid of death. They squat at the door of Jiajia Building every day to follow up.
On the other side, Szeto Fenren has been having a hard time recently. Because of Miss Bauhinia Bauhinia's incident, he was beaten to death by the TV station, and now he has almost become a hard worker. Such a big thing happened in Jiajia Building, and he was the most excited person watching.
